title: 第 16 课 · 开发板：PWM 和 ADC
summary: PWM 引脚在 0 和 3.3 V 之间快速切换：万用表读到平均值，示波器看到方波。ADC 引脚把 0–3.3 V 变成 0–4095 的数。
description:
**这一课学什么**：第 5 期的调光、调速、PWM DAC 和传感器实验都要用 PWM 和 ADC。这一课用一只 LED 和一个电位器把两者都看一遍。

**PWM**（脉宽调制）：引脚以固定频率在“高”（3.3 V）和“低”（0 V）之间切换。一个周期里高电平占的比例叫**占空比**（duty cycle）。
- 万用表（直流档）反应慢，读到的是**平均值** ≈ 占空比 × 高电平；
- 示波器看到的是真实的方波：高电平还是约 3.3 V，只是只亮了一部分时间；
- LED 的亮度跟着平均电流变，但每次“高”的时候电流和常亮时一样大——PWM 不能用来绕过引脚的电流上限。

**ADC**（模数转换）：引脚设成 ADC 时，芯片把 0–3.3 V 的电压换成 12 位的数 0–4095：读数 ≈ 电压 / 3.3 V × 4095。超过 3.3 V 的电压会损坏引脚——传感器电压高的话要先分压。ESP32 只有 GPIO32–39（ADC1）能和 Wi-Fi 一起用。

**电路**：ESP32 的 GPIO2（PWM）→ 330Ω → LED → GND；电位器两端接 3V3 和 GND，滑动端接 GPIO34（ADC）。

**仿真和真实开发板**：这里的 ADC 是理想、线性的。真实 ESP32 的 ADC 在接近 0 V 和 3.3 V 的两头不线性，还有噪声和衰减设置，要校准才准；真实万用表在 1 kHz PWM 上读到的值和表的类型有关（真有效值表的交流档读的是另一回事）。

en.title: Lesson 16 · Dev board: PWM and ADC
en.summary: A PWM pin flips between 0 and 3.3 V: the multimeter reads the average, the scope shows the square wave. An ADC pin turns 0–3.3 V into a number 0–4095.
en.description:
**What you learn**: the dimming, motor-speed, PWM-DAC and sensor labs of phase 5 all use PWM and the ADC. This lesson shows both with one LED and one potentiometer.

**PWM** (pulse-width modulation): the pin switches at a fixed frequency between high (3.3 V) and low (0 V). The fraction of each period spent high is the **duty cycle**.
- A multimeter (DC range) is slow and reads the **average** ≈ duty × high level;
- the scope shows the real square wave: the high level is still about 3.3 V, just for part of the time;
- the LED's brightness follows the average current, but every "high" carries the same current as when it is fully on — PWM is no way around a pin's current limit.

**ADC** (analogue-to-digital converter): with a pin in ADC mode the chip turns 0–3.3 V into a 12-bit number 0–4095: reading ≈ voltage / 3.3 V × 4095. Above 3.3 V the pin is damaged — divide a higher sensor voltage down first. On an ESP32 only GPIO32–39 (ADC1) work together with Wi-Fi.

**Circuit**: ESP32 GPIO2 (PWM) → 330Ω → LED → GND; a potentiometer across 3V3 and GND with its wiper on GPIO34 (ADC).

**Simulated vs real board**: this ADC is ideal and linear. A real ESP32 ADC is non-linear near 0 V and 3.3 V, noisy, and has attenuation settings — it needs calibrating; what a real multimeter shows on a 1 kHz PWM depends on the meter (a true-RMS meter's AC range measures something else).
steps: ESP32 dev board at b1 (as in the previous lesson).
Rails: red jumper j1 → bp1 (3V3), blue jumper j14 → bn14 (GND), blue jumper a7 → tn7 (GND).
GPIO2 has only one free hole, a15, so first take it out to column 20 with a jumper a15 → a20; then the resistor, the multimeter and the scope probe all have room.
Resistor 330Ω c20 → c23; red LED long lead d23, short lead d26; blue jumper a26 → tn26.
Click the board and set **GPIO2** to PWM; click the row to expand it and set the duty cycle to 25 %, frequency 1 kHz. The LED lights, dimmer than fully on.
Multimeter red probe on b20: you read the average voltage, far below 3.3 V.

Scope probe: tip e20, ground clip tn18. A square wave: the high level is still about 3.2 V, for a quarter of each period. When the scope window covers the right half of the board, collapse it with ▾ at its top right, or drag its title bar out of the way.
Change the duty cycle to 75 %: the LED gets brighter and the multimeter reading triples; on the scope the high level is the same, just wider.
Set the duty cycle back to 25 %.
ADC: potentiometer (10kΩ) at h22 (legs at h22, h23, h24); blue jumper j22 → bn22 (GND), red jumper j24 → bp24 (3V3).
Wiper to GPIO34: jumper g23 → j5 (GPIO34 is column 5 of the lower row). Set **GPIO34** to ADC: its row shows the ADC voltage and the 0–4095 reading. Drag the pot and watch it change.
Press "Check my circuit" and answer from the scope, the multimeter and the pin list.
hints: A multimeter's DC range reads the average: average = duty × high level.
On the scope the high level equals the pin voltage when fully on; PWM only changes the fraction of time spent high.
ADC reading = voltage / 3.3 V × 4095; with the wiper in the middle the voltage is half of 3.3 V.
tests: PWM lights the LED; the ADC reads the wiper voltage

measurements.explain: The square wave jumps between 0 V and the high level: 3.3 V minus the drop across the output resistance.
The DC range reads the average: 0.25 × 3.2 V ≈ 0.80 V.

measurements.ask: The LED's average current (click the LED and read its current in Properties, or put an ammeter between R1 and the LED)
measurements.explain: 0.25 × 4.1 mA ≈ 1.0 mA; during the 25 % of the time it is high, it is still 4.1 mA.

measurements.ask: Wiper at 50 %: the voltage on GPIO34 (the ADC reading in the pin list, or the multimeter)
In the same state, about what is GPIO34's 12-bit raw ADC reading?
measurements.explain: 1.65 / 3.3 × 4095 ≈ 2048: 12 bits = 4096 levels, with 3.3 V at full scale.

tests.name: PWM 点亮 LED；ADC 读到滑动端的电压

measurements.explain: 方波在 0 V 和高电平之间跳：高电平是 3.3 V 减去输出电阻上的压降。

measurements.ask: 万用表：GPIO2（第 20 列）对 GND 的电压
LED 的平均电流（单击 LED 看“属性”里的电流，或者在 R1 和 LED 之间串一个电流表）
电位器滑动端在 50 %：GPIO34 的电压（引脚列表的 ADC 读数或万用表）
同一状态下，GPIO34 的 12 位 ADC 原始读数大约是多少？

steps.text: ESP32 开发板放在 b1（和上一课一样）。
电源轨：红色跳线 j1 → bp1（3V3），蓝色跳线 j14 → bn14（GND），蓝色跳线 a7 → tn7（GND）。
GPIO2 只有 a15 一个空孔，先用一根跳线 a15 → a20 把它引到第 20 列，这样电阻、万用表和示波器探头都有地方接。
电阻 330Ω c20 → c23；红色 LED 长脚 d23、短脚 d26；蓝色跳线 a26 → tn26。
单击开发板，把 **GPIO2** 设成 PWM；单击这一行展开，把占空比拖到 25 %，频率 1 kHz。LED 亮了，但比常亮暗。
万用表红表笔点 b20：读到的是平均电压，远低于 3.3 V。
示波器探头：针尖 e20、接地夹 tn18。方波：高电平仍然约 3.2 V，只占每个周期的 1/4。示波器窗口挡住面包板右半边时，点窗口右上角的 ▾ 收起它，或者拖动标题栏把它挪开。
把占空比改成 75 %：LED 变亮，万用表读数变成三倍，示波器上方波的高电平没变，只是变宽了。
ADC：电位器（10kΩ）放在 h22（脚在 h22、h23、h24）；蓝色跳线 j22 → bn22（GND），红色跳线 j24 → bp24（3V3）。
滑动端接 GPIO34：跳线 g23 → j5（GPIO34 在下排第 5 列）。把 **GPIO34** 设成 ADC：这一行显示 ADC 电压和 0–4095 的读数。拖电位器看它变。
点“检查我的电路”，读示波器、万用表和引脚列表完成测量题。

hints: 万用表直流档读的是平均值：平均 = 占空比 × 高电平。
示波器上的方波高电平和常亮时的引脚电压一样，PWM 只改变“高”的时间比例。
ADC 读数 = 电压 / 3.3 V × 4095；滑动端在中间时电压是 3.3 V 的一半。
